policy: Records are metadata and links only; nothing is bundled and nothing downloads by itself. Recommendations are selected in the separate Wallpaper pane. With Follow theme enabled by the user, theme and mode changes prepare the matching curated photograph; otherwise the wallpaper stays independent. The images remain the property of their owners.

lingmo.rationale: Lingmo's accent is blue #3385FF and its look is cool and quiet; both photographs are cool-toned and leave a calm band under the top bar and above the dock.

dark.rationale: Moonlit alpine lake at night with star trails: a deep, dark sky under the top bar and a dark reflection above the dock (dark mode).

light.rationale: Snow-dusted Moraine Lake under low cloud: a pale, quiet sky band under the top bar and calm teal water above the dock (light mode).

lingmo.placement: Both originals are wider than 16:9 or taller; centre-fill crops the sides or the top on a different monitor aspect: the three reviewed crops show what each keeps.
lingmo.crop_policy: keep original aspect; centre-fill crops on aspect mismatch

bar_legibility_note: Supplementary, not part of the catalogue schema: contrast of bar_text against the bar fill at bar_alpha over every 40 px cell of the centre-filled image, per edge and viewport. Lingmo's real bar adds a Gaussian blur and picks its ink from the wallpaper; neither is modelled, so this is a conservative check of what this package draws.
